notes: Rows are shuffled with shuffle_seed before slicing (not raw parquet order). corpus: passages indexed for retrieval; dev: queries used for embedder comparison; eval: held-out queries (disjoint from dev) with is_selected labels. corpus was widened 1000 -> 5000 rows/lang: eval labels sit in [500,1000) and remain covered, so the extra rows act purely as distractors and make the benchmark harder.
